questions.prompt: — —G-R-E-E-N.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你怎么拼它？——G-R-E-E-N。 考查情景交际。What’s your last name你姓什么；What color is it它是什么颜色的；What’s this这是什么；How do you spell it你怎么拼写它。根据“G-R-E-E-N.”可知，询问怎么拼写。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Spell it, please. —.
questions.explanation: 句意：——请拼一下。——A-M-Y。 考查情景交际。I’m Amy我是Amy；A-M-Y艾米的拼写；Amy艾米，人名；This is AMY这是Amy。根据“Spell it, please”可知此处回答单词的拼写，选项B符合。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Good afternoon, class! —
questions.explanation: 句意：——同学们，下午好！——杨老师，下午好！ 考查情景交际。Thank you谢谢；Good afternoon, Mr. Yang杨老师，下午好；Good morning, Mr. Yang杨老师，早上好；Good evening, Mr. Yang杨老师，晚上好。根据“Good afternoon, class!”可知，应回答下午好，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Well, ! The class is over. —Bye, Miss Yang.
questions.explanation: 句意：——好了，就这样！下课。——再见，杨老师。 考查情景交际。that’s OK不客气；that’s it好了，就这样（通常用于结束语）；it’s nothing没什么；it’s all right没关系。根据“The class is over.”可知，这是下课时老师说的话，B选项符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Hello, Jim! —
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，吉姆！——你好，爱丽丝。 考查情景交际。What’s your name你叫什么名字；Fine, thanks很好，谢谢；Hello, Alice你好，爱丽丝。根据“Hello, Jim!”可知，此处是打招呼用语，回答用Hello/Hi，故选C。

questions.prompt: —I’m Judy. Nice to meet you! —
questions.explanation: 句意：——我是朱迪。很高兴认识你！——我也很高兴认识你。 考查情景交际。It’s a pleasure我很乐意；Not at all不客气；Nice to meet you, too我也很高兴认识你；Sure当然。根据“Nice to meet you!”可知，此处应该回答“我也很高兴认识你”，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Joe! ? —Great, thanks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，乔！最近怎么样？——很好，谢谢。 考查情景交际。What are you doing你在做什么；Where are you going你要去哪里；How’s the weather天气怎么样；How’s it going最近怎么样。根据答语“Great, thanks.”可知，此处是询问对方近况，故选D。

questions.prompt: —How are you doing? —.

questions.prompt: —Nice to meet you. —_
questions.explanation: 句意：——很高兴见到你。——我也很高兴见到你。 考查情景交际。Nice to meet you too.我也很高兴见到你；You’re welcome.不客气；See you later.再见。“Nice to meet you.”是一种打招呼的方式，应用“Nice to meet you too.”回答。故选A。

questions.prompt: —How is your brother doing? —_.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你弟弟怎么样？——他很好，谢谢。 考查情景交际。He is doing sports他在做运动；He is fine, thanks他很好，谢谢；He is doing very well他做得很好。根据“How is your brother doing”可知此处回答弟弟的身体状况，选项B符合。故选B。

questions.prompt: —I’m Zhaxi. Nice to meet you! —.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我是卓嘎。很高兴认识你！——也很高兴认识你。 考查情景交际。It’s a pleasure乐意为您效劳；Not at all没什么；Nice to meet you, too也很高兴认识你；How do you do你好吗。根据“Nice to meet you”可知此处表示问候，用“也很高兴见到你”进行回答。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mom, I’ve finished my homework. I’m going to bed. —
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我已经做完作业了。我要去睡觉了。——晚安，亲爱的。 考查交际用语。Good night, dear晚安，亲爱的；I’m fine我很好；See you再见；Enjoy yourself玩得高兴。根据“I’m going to bed.”可知应跟孩子说晚安。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Tony, why do you want to be the P. E. monitor? —Because I run fast and play most ball games well.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼，你为什么想当体育课代表？——因为我跑得快，大多数球类运动都打得好。 考查动词辨析。can能，可以；would将；may也许。根据“Because I...run fast”可知，此处表示能跑得快，表示能力。故选A。

questions.prompt: Although she is eighty-five, she still read without glasses.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然她八十五岁了，但她仍然能不戴眼镜看书。 考查情态动词。could可以，能，常用于表示请求的语境；might可能；must必须；can能。根据“Although she is eighty-five”可知，此处指的是“能看见”，应用can，故选D。

questions.prompt: — butter do you need for your sandwich, Alice? —One spoon is enough.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的三明治需要多少黄油，爱丽丝？——一勺就够了。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少，修饰可数名词；How much多少，修饰不可数名词；How often多久一次；How long多长时间。根据“One spoon is enough.”可知，询问需要多少黄油，butter是不可数名词，应用how much。故选B。

questions.prompt: —_ oranges do we need to make fruit salad? —Three should be enough.
questions.explanation: 句意：——做水果沙拉需要多少橙子？——三个应该就够了。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多久一次；How much多少钱；How many多少。根据“Three should be enough.”可知，是对数量进行提问，且“oranges”为可数名词。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Matt, how old is your father this year? —. And we just had a party for his birthday yesterday.

questions.prompt: —What’s 7:10 in English? —It’s .

questions.prompt: — What color is your new coat? —

There are ... cows on the farm.”可知，此处表示数百头牛，应用hundreds of。故选C。 [图片引用：解析Starter Unit 3 课时3 Section B（1a-2c）（分层作业）（解析版）43.assets/image4.png] 三、阅读理解 Yuan Longping is known as China’s “Father of Hybrid Rice（杂交水稻）”. He won the World Food Prize（世界粮食奖）for his work to help feed so many people in 2004. Yuan was born in 1930. When he was a child, his mother taught him English and told him stories in English. Yuan Longping spent a lot of time with his mother and he loved his mother very much. He studied agriculture（农业）and showed an interest in plants from an early age. In 1974, he grew a new kind of rice called hybrid rice. Farmers can grow it on many different kinds of <u>land</u>. It can fight bad weather and disease, too. It makes 20% more rice than any other kind. Today, half of China’s rice plants are Yuan’s special hybrid rice. China uses Yuan’s hybrid rice to grow much more rice than before. It also helped many countries grow more rice. Yuan was a great scientist. But he called himself a farmer. He spent most of his time in the field. We should always remember this great scientist because he really worked hard and did a lot for our country and the world.

options: i<u>t</u> 【答案】C 【详解】句意：下面句子中哪处发音可以失去爆破？ 考查语音知识。失去爆破：当一个爆破音后面紧跟着另一个爆破音时，前面的爆破音不发生爆破。判断方法是：对于前一个爆破音，只作发音的姿势，刚要发出时，立即发出第二个爆破音。 这种现象叫做失去爆破。根据四个单词的发音可知，like的发音为/laɪk/，而cutting的发音为/ˈkʌtɪŋ/，两个爆破音，第一个失去爆破。故选C。

questions.prompt: 下列属于不完全爆破的是 。
options: would you 【答案】A 【详解】句意：下列属于不完全爆破的是stop talking。 考查语音知识。英语中的爆破音有/p/、/b/、/t/、/d/、/k/、/g/，这6个爆破音中的任何两个音素相邻时，前者发不完全爆破音，后者则要完全地，彻底地进行爆破。stop talking的音标 [stɒp ˈtɔːkɪŋ\]中/p/和/t/都是爆破音，且相邻， 所以是不完全爆破音。故选A。

questions.prompt: I have <u>discovered</u> the person who broke the window.
options: watched 【答案】A 【详解】句意：我已经找到打破窗户的人了。 考查动词词义辨析。found找到，发现；seen看见；watched观看。“discovered” 通常意味着找到了一些之前未知或隐藏的事物。在这个句子中，它强调了找到了那个打破了窗户的人，这可能是在一番搜索或调查之后才实现的。因此， “found” 可以用作 “discovered” 的同义词，但是 “seen” 和 “watched” 在这个特定的上下文中不太合适。故选A。
